LESSON: ADDITION (8

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.2: Addition (8
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Addition (8, part of Numbers in Grade 4 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: When can you useaddition in real life? 2. 2. How can you make number patterns involving addition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. jointly work with others to add up totwo 4-digit numbers with single regrouping up to a sum of 10,000 using number cards, charts or place value apparatus,

2. team up with others to add up to two 4-digit numbers with double regrouping up to a sum of 10,000 inreal- life situations,

3. discuss and estimate the sum by rounding off numbers to the nearest ten in different situations,

4. jointly work with peers to generate patterns involving the addition of numbers up to a sum of 10,000, 1. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. jointly work with others to add up totwo 4-digit numbers with single regrouping up to a sum of 10,000 using number cards, charts or place value apparatus,
2. team up with others to add up to two 4-digit numbers with double regrouping up to a sum of 10,000 inreal- life situations,
3. discuss and estimate the sum by rounding off numbers to the nearest ten in different situations,
4. jointly work with peers to generate patterns involving the addition of numbers up to a sum of 10,000, 1. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Addition (8 together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: learner successfully uses number cards, place value charts or place value apparatus to add up

to two 4-digit numbers with single regrouping with the sum not exceeding 10,000.

• Creativity and imagination: learner, in groups, generates patterns involving addition up to a sum of 10,000.

Values:
Unity: learner works jointly to add up to two 4-digit numbers with double regrouping up to a sum of 10,000 in

real-life situations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social Cohesion: learner amicably teams up with others in adding up to two 4-digit numbers with single

regrouping up to a sum of 10,000.

• Peer Education: learner supports others in generating patterns involving the addition of numbers up to a sum

of 10,000.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate adding up to two 4-digit numbers with single regrouping to adding quantities in

Science and Technology.
